name: Machine Hip Adduction
steps: Set the starting angle to a comfortable spread and sit with your back against the pad.
Rest your inner thighs against the pads above your knees and hold the side handles to steady your pelvis.
Squeeze your inner thighs smoothly together to draw the pads toward the center until they nearly meet.
Allow the pads to open slowly back to the starting stretch under full control.
tips: Start with a comfortable stretch width rather than forcing an overly wide starting position.
Avoid jerking the legs together quickly; use a slow, controlled tempo.
